'''Kuuda De Nall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
De Nall flew a [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210]] light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and once traveled to the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[StarForge Station]], where she became romantically involved with the proprietor of the [[StarForge Shipyard]], [[Chidee Na Maak]]. Na Maak keep insisting that she let him upgrade her ship and then personally carried out all the modifications for her. The course of their relationship became the subject of number of wagers among the other inhabitants of the station.
